quantity: SO2 contribution from three selected industrial sources only

colour.note: Absolute nonnegative source increments; white-to-blue encodes increasing magnitude. Grey alternative uses the same normalization.

time_policy: Native means represent [h,h+1]. Display linearly interpolates scalar diagnostics at interval centres, clamps first/last half-hour. Bilinear scalar upsampling improves display edges while native queries, curves and downloads remain unchanged. No rendered-image or RGB frame blending.
receptor_policy: Five virtual geographic positions; bilinear interpolation of native hourly 0–20m means. Rolling24 uses complete preceding 24 hourly intervals, first23 unavailable.
urban_lowland_definition: lon -123.25..-122.90, lat49.10..49.33, native terrain<80m; includes water, not a municipal mask; area x hour weighted
map_geography: Native model terrain contours are schematic geography, not surveyed coastline; coordinates WGS84, fixed aspect cos(49.25deg).

limitations: 2024 annual emission rates held constant, with historical stack thermal priors.
No qualified evolving initial background, external chemical inflow, or total ambient SO2.
Native 0–20m cell means are not 2m exposure measurements; finite particle sampling creates exact model zeros.
0–1600m diagnostic is maximum layer mean, not column-integrated mass.
15-day weather forecast uncertainty is not quantified by the 24h CPU-consistency qualification.

geographic_basemap.source: Cached Mapzen/Terrarium elevation tiles, z11, approximately50m source spacing; display resampled
geographic_basemap.coastline_role: Approximate DEM-derived water/land boundary at0.8m; not surveyed hydrography

display_smoothing.interpolation: Separable shape-preserving PCHIP, scalar values before colour mapping

video.frame_interpolation: Scalar diagnostic interpolation only, each image independently rendered

web_display_encoding.encoding: Q8 logarithmic scalar storage, decoded toF32 before temporal/spatial interpolation and colour mapping

web_load_policy: Current scalar time pair first; remaining24-hour blocks prefetch in the background. Native map cells load on demand by day.
